rows.text: Owned Ghidra checkpoints save the initial Program and every acknowledged metadata edit. Restores use a verified private copy without rerunning auto-analysis, and preserve the original timeout and seed identity. Original executable bytes are never written.
After retirement, reopen the target to resolve its saved generation; an old profile cannot silently restart from changed state. Publisher locks are not reclaimed automatically after owner crashes.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
Only resolved Ghidra call references are returned; unresolved computed or indirect calls remain unknown, while function classifications distinguish thunks and externals.
